extracted.summary: Scholarship for students from Class 11 to postgraduate level, providing financial assistance to underprivileged students.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an income up to INR 4,00,000 for salaried employees, and up to INR 2,50,000 for others.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be a student of class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, graduation or postgraduation, in General Fields, Medical or Engineering.
extracted.max_age_quote: Applicants must be below 30 years of age.
extracted.deadline_quote: Always Open. Applications are received round the year.
